name: Great Books
blurb: Read fourteen short passages from the Bible, Plato, Epictetus, Marcus Aurelius, Augustine, Boethius, Bacon, Franklin, Jefferson, Lincoln, Emerson, Thoreau, Darwin and Chesterton in their exact public-domain words, and learn the hard words, key ideas and facts a well-read person knows.

sources.t: Thoughts of Marcus Aurelius, tr. George Long, with Long's life of the emperor (eBook #6920)
The Enchiridion, tr. T. W. Higginson, with introduction (eBook #45109)
The Consolation of Philosophy, tr. H. R. James, with proem (eBook #14328)
